description: This file declares the SysVMessageQueue class which provides an interface for inter-process message queue handling using System V IPC. It includes methods for creating, sending, and receiving messages via message queues.

classes.name: SysVMessageQueue
classes.description: A class managing System V IPC message queues, providing methods for creating, sending, and receiving messages.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new SysVMessageQueue instance with a given queue name.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data to the message queue, optionally blocking.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Receives data from the message queue, optionally blocking.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the message queue with a message ID and auto-close flag.

methods.name: ~SysVMessageQueue
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the message queue if auto-close is enabled.
